review: The library is now a QWidget page, not a nested native dialog. Existing note storage/index and exact identities remain. Deferred first population plus prepare refresh scans the note folder once per opening; debounce remains. Retained QSplitter and preview preserve search/selection/scroll/column width. Source-verified catalogue labels distinguish duplicate stage names. Actions are non-default after reproducing Enter accidentally opening the editor. Header actions are also non-default. Redundant panel window title and resize removed; the host owns sizing. No new catches, source wrappers, packages or private-state restore.
